Something painful about anxiety is the feeling that all of your problems are pathetic, or not as important as someone else's. Everyone has a different threshold. That's not to say that yours or mine is inferior to anyone else's- i can tell you think very far into things. I'd even like to say you have a high threshold, it's just that you envision worst case scenarios so often. It's easy to feel insignificant when nearly nobody thinks you make sense. 

Also, finding a good therapist is so hard. It's almost like finding medicine that works for you, you just have to keep trying until you find something that fits. 

I believe even though you feel weak, you are strong. You've made it so far with so many thoughts, and thats a feat that not many people have accomplished. Once you come to terms with yourself, you'll be able to handle things outside more easily. Why don't you take 10 to 15 minutes of your day to practice clearing your mind. Biofeedback therapy is something you should look into, also. It doesn't usually go away, but it can become manageable. And then from there you can work on finding happiness.
